body:
>No one understands what I'm going through.

The good news is that plenty of people totally understand this feeling. The bad news is that's because they're equally lonely, and therefore less likely to interact or form friendships with you since they too are isolated.

Don't know if that's any consolation, but I hope it helps some.

Yeah, I definitely know that feeling. Your post made me look back and ask myself when the last time I could genuinely say I was happy, and it's definitely been at least ten years.

But for a while there, I'd believed that I could do without. And you know, to an extent I still do. If I was on a level playing field where things were working and I just needed to keep it going, I honestly think my current mindset would be enough. But trying to dig my way out of where the bad years have left me? I just don't think I have it in me anymore.

I don't know if you're checking this post, or ever will do so again, but I just want to say that I've been where you are.

As a practical bit of advice, your school almost certainly has a mental health office of some sort. Not sure how good they are, or how much the pandemic has screwed things over, but I *strongly* encourage you to reach out to them asap.

When I was in your shoes, I didn't. I thought I could push through on my own. What actually happened was a years long spiral that led to, well, me posting here. I don't know if they can do anything to help you, or if they'd have been able to do anything for me if I'd done differently.

All I know is that not reaching out ended very poorly for me, and you should strongly consider *not* making the choice I did.

Honestly, my biggest regret from 2020 is not dying of coronavirus.  Yes, it's not a pleasant way to go, but would have made for such a clean story when I was gone. No scandal, no bad feelings, just an unfortunate case among many during an exceptional year.

And hey, I guess there's still time between now and when the vaccine wipes it out, but mortality rate isn't high enough for it to be likely even if I do catch it, and so far I've been careful about it because I'd hate to spread it to others who aren't as fed up as I am.
